study.design: market survey with health risk assessment
study.origin: not stated (international, national and local products)
study.market: popular drinking joints (pubs), Club Road, Awka, Anambra State, Nigeria
study.method: perchloric/nitric acid wet digestion of 2 mL, flame AAS (Agilent AA500F), triplicate
lod: LOD = 3 SD of blank; LOQ = 2 x LOD; values not printed
study.qa: reference material recoveries 93.5% (Cd) to 105.5% (Ni); reagent blanks subtracted
